description: Find projects by a description of the idea, by similarity to one or more projects already on hand, or by conditions on their measured profile — quality axes, scale band, growth direction, country, site type — in any combination. Every project in the corpus is a site where revenue has been observed; how much a site earns and what it charges is not part of this corpus. Returns cards: id, short description, site type, quality index, scale band, growth, main country and niche. The domain appears only on projects your organization has revealed; reveal_project turns a card into a domain. With text or seed projects, the results are the projects closest in meaning, the seeds themselves left out; sorting by index, scale or growth then orders the closest ones only, as many as relevance_pool in capabilities. Costs the base price plus the first-seen price for every project shown to your organization for the first time this period, and each such project spends one unit of coverage; without limit a call returns as many rows as list_max in capabilities allows. Call with estimate: true to see the price and get a quote_token first. Use it when your user describes a kind of site or the niche is already known; for a market question start with search_cohorts, and for a domain your user already has use lookup_domain.

anti_seed.description: Projects the results should not resemble; needs text or seed, and must not repeat a seed

items.description: Opaque project id as returned by this server to your organization

cursor.description: Continue a previous page: repeat the same query parameters (limit may change) and pass the cursor it returned

estimate.description: When true, run the query but return only its composition, price and a quote_token instead of data

exclude.description: Projects already seen, to leave out; refused above cursor_depth in capabilities

items.description: Opaque project id as returned by this server to your organization

cohort_id.description: Restrict to the core members of this niche; projects on its edge (edge: true in a project card's niches) are left out

limit.description: Rows to return; defaults to list_max in capabilities and is refused above it

quote_token.description: Execute a previous estimate: pass the quote_token instead of the query parameters

seed.description: Projects the results should resemble; they are left out of the results; seed and anti_seed together are refused above list_max in capabilities

items.description: Opaque project id as returned by this server to your organization

sort.description: relevance (closeness to text and seed; the default with them, and it requires them), index (total quality index; the default without text or seed), scale (monthly visits) or growth (last-month change); with text or seed, index, scale and growth order the relevance_pool closest projects

text.description: Free-text description of the idea to look for

name: search_projects
title: Find projects
